heroHeading: Specialist Care for Pianos, Antiques & Fine Art
heroSubheading: Piano and antique removals in Birmingham by specialist two-to-four-person crews, for upright pianos, grandfather clocks, marble tables and family heirlooms. We use padded piano shoes, stair skids and tail-lift loading to move heavy and delicate items without damaging them or your floors.
summary: Transporting an upright piano, spinet, antique sideboard, or heavy domestic safe requires specialized equipment and experienced heavy-item movers. Our Birmingham removal company utilizes heavy-duty piano dollies, thick quilted transit jackets, rubber stair skids, and 500kg electric hydraulic tail-lifts to eliminate manual lifting strain and prevent floor scuffs. Your valuable instrument is secured with industrial ratchet straps in our carpeted Luton van and transported under Fully insured specialist insurance.
benefits: Heavy-duty piano shoes, quilted transit jackets, and non-marking dollies
Hydraulic tail-lift Luton vans ensuring zero jolting during loading
Tailored stair-climbing gear and heavy-duty load strapping
Enhanced Fully insured insurance for declared high-value items

process.title: Access & Instrument Appraisal
process.description: We evaluate piano dimensions, weight, flights of stairs, tight corner turns, and entrance thresholds at both pickup and drop-off points.

process.title: Custom Protective Padding
process.description: The instrument is wrapped in thick, quilted moving blankets, secured onto a reinforced piano shoe, and wrapped with protective film.

process.title: Hydraulic Van Loading
process.description: Using heavy-duty non-slip ramps and tail lifts, the item is rolled smoothly into the van and anchored firmly against cargo lashing rails.

process.title: Careful Positioning in New Room
process.description: We wheel and settle your piano into its designated room, positioning it away from direct radiators or damp external walls.

whatsIncluded: Specialist upright piano moving crew (2 to 4 technicians)
Padded piano shoe, heavy-duty wheeled dolly, and transit covers
Fully insured insurance coverage up to declared item value
Floor runners to protect parquet, tiles, and delicate carpets
whatsNotIncluded: Tuning services (we advise waiting 2 weeks after moving before tuning)
External window removal or mobile crane hiring for upper floor access
Transport of concert grand pianos requiring complete leg disassembly without notice
priceNotes: Achievable starting price for a ground-floor to ground-floor upright piano move within a 10-mile radius in the West Midlands.

faqs.question: Do you move upright pianos up or down flights of stairs?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can move upright pianos across external or internal steps using specialised ramp systems and multi-crew lifting straps. Please specify the exact step count during your quote request.

faqs.question: Will my piano need retuning after the move?
faqs.answer: Yes. Any movement and transition between varying room temperatures and humidity levels causes string tension to adjust. We recommend giving the piano 10-14 days to acclimate in its new environment before booking your tuner.

faqs.question: Can you move heavy antique furniture like Welsh dressers or grandfather clocks?
faqs.answer: Yes. We regularly move antique armoires, grandfather clocks (with weights and pendulums separately secured), marble tables, and display cabinets.

faqs.question: Are you fully insured for high-value antiques?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our standard Fully insured insurance provides Fully insured, and we can arrange extended cover for declared individual items of exceptional value.
